title: ProgramMembership
description: Used to describe membership in a loyalty programs (e.g. "StarAliance"), traveler clubs (e.g. "AAA"), purchase clubs ("Safeway Club"), etc.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

hostingOrganization.title: Hosting Organization
hostingOrganization.description: The Organization (airline, travelers' club, retailer, etc.) the membership is made with or which offers the  MemberProgram.

member.title: Member
member.description: A member of an Organization or a ProgramMembership. Organizations can be members of organizations; ProgramMembership is typically for individuals.

membershipNumber.title: Membership Number
membershipNumber.description: A unique identifier for the membership.

membershipPointsEarned.title: Membership Points Earned
membershipPointsEarned.description: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: QuantitativeValue [value-type]: QuantitativeValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing

programName.title: Program Name
programName.description: The program providing the membership. It is preferable to use [:program](https://schema.org/program) instead.
